app.name: NeuroCapture
app.live: Connected to your hospital records · live
app.notStored: Names, MRNs and history are read live from your hospital's records for this view. They are not saved by NeuroCapture.

auth.title: Sign in
auth.setupHint: Scan this code with an authenticator app (for example Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator), then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
auth.inviteHint: Choose a password of at least 10 characters, with letters and numbers.
auth.inviteDone: Password set. Sign in to continue.

errors.connector_unreachable: Cannot reach your hospital connector. Check the hospital network or VPN.
errors.account_locked: Too many wrong attempts. Ask an admin to unlock your account.
errors.weak_password: Choose a longer password with letters and numbers.
errors.email_in_use: This e-mail address is already used.
errors.operator_id_in_use: This operator ID is already used.
errors.connector_not_registered: Register the hospital connector first (Data connections).
errors.not_an_ed25519_key: That is not a connector public key.
errors.storage_check_failed: The storage test failed. Check the role and bucket.
errors.records_unavailable: Your hospital records are not answering right now.
errors.http_409: This conflicts with the current state.

hospital.connectorKey: Connector public key (from python -m ncconnector keygen)
hospital.sampleMrn: One sample MRN for the records test
hospital.keysHint: Created on the connector with python -m ncconnector rotate-take-key. Phones encrypt each recording for the active key.
hospital.noKey: No key yet: phones cannot record until the connector registers one.
hospital.externalId: ExternalId for the role's trust policy
hospital.patientsTitle: Invite patients to record at home
hospital.search: Search your records: name or MRN
hospital.viaEmail: E-mail with QR code and link (free)
hospital.viaSms: SMS link and code (paid by your hospital)
hospital.viaPrint: Print QR to hand over at the visit
hospital.deletionHint: The patient withdrew consent and asked for deletion. Delete the recordings in your storage, then mark it done.
hospital.clinicalEvents: Clinical activity (kept in your hospital's database)

doctor.fetchedNow: From your hospital records · fetched just now
doctor.unavailable: Your hospital system is not answering. The recordings below still open.
doctor.decrypted: Videos from your storage, decrypted by your connector
doctor.rerecordDone: The patient's app now shows a new recording as due.
doctor.biomarkerHint: Computed at your hospital from the 60 fps videos; results written to your database under the NCID. Decision support only, not a diagnosis.
